title: Second analyst
lines: I joined a seed-stage dating app before product-market fit.
My work spanned product, growth and user behavior.

title: Building the first view
lines: I set up the V0 top-down dashboards for creator management.
They gave the team an early way to see what was happening.

title: Finding early signals
lines: I tested early implementations and strategies to understand whether the concept had traction.
I also looked at individual user sessions to understand behavior.
